# Bloub motion adaptation

The bounded three-dot pulse in `assets/mascot-cues.js` is adapted from
[Bloub](https://github.com/jeremy-prt/bloub), by Jérémy Perret (2026), specifically
[`src/bot/states.ts`](https://github.com/jeremy-prt/bloub/blob/main/src/bot/states.ts).
The original MIT copyright and permission notice is in [LICENSE](LICENSE).

The workshop uses a restrained adaptation of the `thinking` and `wink` states:
- one left-to-right pulse below the FDE / QA avatar on entering its example chat;
- one wider, flattened eye on the closing Grok avatar;
- unchanged uploaded shapes, colors and native idle/blinking eye keyframes;
- no body morph, imported animation engine, new framework or live task status.

Bloub's README describes 14 states and 16 expressions. Its MIT license covers
its code, not the x.ai avatar design that inspired it. Bloub is not affiliated
with, endorsed by or connected to x.ai; “Grok” and “x.ai” belong to their owners.
These workshop mascots are owner-supplied artwork, not claimed as official assets.
